verdict: FAIL all 4 gates -> PDT simulation stays exactly as-is on paper
interpretation: The engine's self-imposed paper PDT constraint was mildly PROTECTIVE, not costly. The only positive day is 2026-08-04, the same trend day that dominates every other study. Relaxing PDT on paper would have bought 68 extra trades for -$62 and a worse day-balance.
method: Logged qty + premium per blocked intent, real OPRA 5-min bars, real exit_manager via multileg_exit_walk at calibration v5 (extreme fills, $0.01 slippage, SPY union feed); exit shape = that account's params.json config.
limitations_carried_from_prereg: Naive counterfactual (no sequential PDT-window re-simulation); n=18 below the n>=20 advisory bar. Both were stated BEFORE the run and neither is load-bearing for a FAIL.
scope_note: This tested the PAPER-side simulation only. PDT is a real regulatory rule for live accounts under $25k and was never in question there.

companion_findings.trade_ordinal: No ordinal effect on broker P&L (n=274): 1st trade of day/arm mean -$8 WR 20%, all subsequent mean -$5 WR 19%. Trade sequencing is not a lever.
companion_findings.coverage_unlock: Same night: placement_configs() was blind to safe-2/bold-2 (core accounts); recovery took the replayable population 193 -> 240 of 274.
